newsitem.title: USA: Interface eliminates Series A stock.
newsitem.headline: Interface eliminates Series A stock.

text.p: Interface Inc said it completed a program resulting in the elimination of its Series A cumulative convertible preferred stock.

In December 1996, the company said it notified its Series A preferred shareholders that it intended to redeem up to $10 million of the approximately $19.7 million (face value) Series A preferred stock then outstanding.

As a result of this notice, the Series A preferred shareholders, with one exception, instead elected to convert their shares of Series A preferred stock into an aggregate of about 1.36 million shares of the company's publicly traded Class A Common Stock, a statement from Interface said.
The shares of Series A preferred stock owned by the non-converting shareholder are being redeemed for about $6,000, the statement said.
An aggregate of $25 million (face value) Series A preferred stock was issued by the company in 1993 in connection with the company's acquisition of Bentley Mills Inc.
